title: Lake Louise 、Moraine and Emerald Lake Tour from Calgary Banff

the total travelling time will be 10-12 hours if you join the tour from Calgary and back to Calgary. It needs at least 4 hours for the round trip between Calgary and Lake Louise.

Our itinerary starts from Calgary at 7:30 AM, arriving in Canmore around 8:30 AM. We will depart from Canmore around 8:40 AM, arriving in Banff around 9:10 AM, and then depart from Banff around 9:20 AM. Please pay attention to your departure locations and times.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
